metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to instantly relieve inner thigh pain and groin pain.

A main cause of pain in the inner thigh and groin is due to a blend of weakness and tightness in the muscles (in this area). Notably, this includes the adductor muscle group.

To make fixing this easy, this video will be broken up into two separate parts that focus on lengthening and strengthening these muscles for both quick and long-lasting relief. 

To get the best results, go through all the exercises and use what gives the most relief.

Watch now for inner thigh and groin pain relief!
